Dialogs.Dialog: I was just thinking if I ran into you here, I'd get a good grade on my test this afternoon.
It will, it will! I feel like I've got a burst of energy now.
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What're you up to？
...Huh？ When did I wander over here...？
I smelled something yummy, so I was following it. Hmm, guess it's gone.
Haha, you're just hungry, aren't you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hey, that's not it! I could've sworn I smelled something, though...
●'s just wandering around. You too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Nope, a teacher gave me an errand. I'm on my way to grab some lab equipment for chemistry.
Huh, sounds heavy. ●'ll come with you.
Are you sure...？ Well, maybe I will take you up on that. Sorry during your break.
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm looking for something to read. Any recommendations？
Well, I've got plenty, but... What kind of thing are you looking for？
If I say "anything"... am I gonna end up with horror？
Hey, I don't only read horror! Though if you want horror, I can give you a lineup that'll haunt your dreams ▼
...I'd like to be able to use the bathroom tonight, so I think I'll pass.
Just taking a breather. How about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Same here. I thought I got plenty of sleep last night, but I almost nodded off in class.
Yeah. But seeing your face perked me right up. Mmm, time to power through!
...Ugh, I'm gonna get you back for that...
Aw, I'm sorry. Forgive me？ Pretty please？
Sorry, you were with friends. Did I interrupt？
No, not at all. It's never a bother when you call for me.
▲主人公＊▲. Well, I was researching something, but every time I look up one thing, another pops up.
I went so far down the rabbit hole that I forgot what I was even looking for. Mmm...
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, you walked through the breezeway earlier, didn't you？
Yeah, moving classrooms... Wait, how'd you know？ You can barely see it from here.
If it's you, I'd know even without seeing your face？ By your outline, or maybe just your vibe.
...Ah, yeah. I guess it's the same for ●, too. When we meet up, I can spot ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ from way off.
You were daydreaming, so I thought I'd wake you up. Awake now？
Wide awake! Whew, you startled me...
Look at you all flustered. There's no one around, so don't worry, okay？
(If our classmates heard that, it'd be pretty awkward...)
Do you have a Japanese- English dictionary？ I need it this afternoon, but I left mine at home...
Sure, hold on a second. I'll go get it.
Whew, thank goodness! Thanks. The English teacher is really scary when she gets mad...
(Different grades mean no borrowing textbooks, but dictionaries work. Kinda nice.)
Hehe, did you think I was a teacher？
No, I knew it was ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ right away.
Then why were you so jumpy？ Ah, don't tell me you did something to make me mad...？
(It was just really loud, that's all...)
Just when I spotted you, you went walking right on ahead.
Well, you were pretty far. Shouting in the hallway is a bit much, you know？
(When ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s in a teasing mood, she totally would...)
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Math, I think. Why？
Because you were walking around with a total 'what a pain' look on your face.
Did I really look like that？
You totally did! And now you're playing dumb. Hehe.
●'s just returning a book. What about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
The drama finale was yesterday. I recorded it, but everyone's talking about how it ends...
(There's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. All right, time to scare her...)
Hehe, trying to scare Nene-san？ You've got a lot to learn!
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I wasn't sleeping, okay？
Liar. Your head was bobbing all over.
Hehe, you're so cute. Almost done for the day, so hang in there!
Yeah. Are you doing that too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yup. Look at that, we match.
...Ah! I left it by the incinerator!
(She never makes mistakes like that at work, though...)
(Let's see, where was that book again...?)
Oh, excuse me. ...Oh, it's just you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Geez, what's that supposed to mean, 'just you'？
Eh？ Uh... Score! I touched ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s hand!
Hehe... Geez, you're so cute, I'll let it slide▼
What's wrong？ You're totally spaced out.
Yeah... I was deep in thought about the Japanese economy, global warming, and political issues...
Hehe, big fat liar. If you've got time, wanna chat for a bit？
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ The bell's gonna ring soon, you know？
Yup. Next period's in that music room over there.
I see. Maybe I'll hear you singing during class, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I won't be that loud! Hehe, see ya.
(Looks like she hasn't noticed me at all. She's singing happily away...)
No way, seriously？ How long were you there？ Geez...
(...She doesn't need to be so embarrassed.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what are you doing？ Looking around everywhere.
▲主人公＊▲. We have sketching in art class soon, so I'm scouting out a good spot while I have the chance.
Oh, you do that in art？ Hope you find a nice spot to draw.
Yup. When I find a good one, I'll let you know!
Shh! I'm with friends. I've gotta go right away.
Aw, don't look so bummed! You'll make me not want to leave. See ya later, okay？
Wow, there are so many people out today.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah, probably because the weather's so nice.
On days like this, I'd love to pack a lunch and go for a hike. Oh, climbing a mountain sounds fun too!
Huh？ But ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you'd get tired right away.
Now you've said it! With my sweet boyfriend escorting me, I'll make it all the way to the top, you know!
...Oh, there he is. Thank you so much!
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What are you doing in our classroom？
I was passing by and peeked in. Then someone was nice enough to go look for you...
Yep. Looks like we're official in your friends' eyes, huh？
(Well, it's not like we're hiding it anyway.)
▲主人公＊▲. I have a vocab test, so I'm memorizing words. I just couldn't focus in class.
Oh, really？ Sorry, did I interrupt you？
Not at all. Hey, could you quiz me？ From here to here in my vocab book.
Okay. All right, I'm not going easy on you？
Oh, perfect timing! Have you seen a light blue handkerchief？
Haven't seen it... Want me to help you look？
Thanks! It's my friend's. She had it drying by the window, and the wind blew it away.
...Hmm？ Isn't that it right there, caught on that tree branch？
Ah, you're right! Wow, great job! Good boy, good boy, ▼!
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Yeah, thought I'd finish it before heading home.
I see. Maybe I will too. Mind if I sit next to you？
Of course. Sweet, can you help me with this part right here？
Ah, look at you taking advantage. Hehe.
Oh, you were here？ You should've said something.
Yeah, but you were with your friends.
Oh, listen to you. ...Hehe, you're really close, huh？
Oh, did you have business in the staff room too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah, dropping off some handouts. What about you？ Get called in for being naughty？
No way. Just returning a key.
Hmm. Well, let's just go with that.
Yeah. You were looking for a place to sit, right？ Have a seat next to me.
Thanks. Mind if I interrupt your reading while I'm at it？
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What're you doing here？
I'm joining the tennis club starting today.
Geez, did you have to look that surprised？ Just kidding, I'm only waiting for a friend.
Thought so. No way ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ would... right？
What's that supposed to mean？ Would it be weird if I joined the tennis club？
Huh？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you on cleaning duty here？
Yep. It's our class's turn this month.
Gotcha. Guess I won't litter this month, then.
Good. ...Wait, no littering, even when it's NOT this month!
Haha, just kidding. Good work today.
Hmm, I've read this one too...
▲主人公＊▲. I was looking for a fun book in a long series. Got any recommendations？
Hmm, if I had any, I think I'd have told you by now.
True enough... Guess I'll have to venture into new territory.
Yeah. If you find a good one, let ● know too.
▲主人公＊▲. Have you seen Takahashi-sensei, from music？
Haven't seen them. Aren't they in the music room？
No. They disappeared with the music room key. I forgot my pencil case in there, and I need to get it...
The staff room said to check the store, the store said the roof, and on the roof, they said back toward the music room...
Got the runaround, huh？ Want me to lend you some pens for now？
Thanks, that helps. *sigh* I'll have to go look again later...
Ah, there you are. Hey, can I take your picture？
My friend had tons of photos of her boyfriend on her phone, and I got jealous. She was bragging all lunch break.
I don't mind, but there are people watching around here...
？ You're silly. It's not like there's anything weird about it.
Hehe, I just wanted to see your face.
No, I really just wanted to see your face. How should I put it... It's not like I had any real reason for it...
I see. That's fine, you don't need a reason. ●'s happy to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s face, too.
Excuse me, mister~ Got a minute？
Hehe, who did you think it was？
You sounded like you were trying to solicit me...
At school？ If you space out like that, someone really will scam you. You'd better be careful, okay？
Excuse me! Could you grab our ball？
Oh, it was you! You were in the shadow of the building, so I couldn't tell.
Volleyball？ Be careful not to jam a finger.
Hehe, will do! Thanks for the ball!
(She's reading with such a serious look. Maybe I shouldn't bother her...)
Hehe, I felt your gaze, you know？ All prickling.
...Whew, the breeze feels nice, doesn't it？
What's that for？ You sound like we're on shift.
Well, for students, studying is pretty much our job, too.
Listen to you, talk about cheeky. Well then, shall we put in another shift？
Did you see a swallow？ One flew into the classroom through the window, so we were chasing it to get it out...
Did it flee down the hall？ I haven't seen it around here.
I see, maybe it made it outside... Got it, thanks!
A friend of mine dropped her contact lens.
Right here？ Want ● to help too？
Thanks. It might already be too late, but she won't give up till she sees it for herself.
The poster by the entrance is peeling, but I can't quite reach it. Could you fix it for me？
Sure thing. Ah, could you take the order for the customer who just came in, then？
Oh, looks like it really was just a calculation error. They gave the right change.
I see, that's a relief. Oh, and what about that other...？
The new menu for next month？ Printing got delayed, but the manager said it should be here by tomorrow.
Nene-kun, sorry to interrupt your break. Got a second？
Man... Whenever anything happens, the manager always relies on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You think so？ Well, I'll be right back, so be a good boy and wait for me, okay？
(...Wait, why'd I just nod along？ That's ● for you...)
...That group just now, turns out they're a college club.
Really？ They looked pretty mature, though.
I wonder if I'll change like that once I'm in college, too.
Even if you did, I probably wouldn't notice. Since we're always together.
Hey, hey! They're feeding us after work today!
A sample menu tasting! Apparently there's more food than everyone on shift today can possibly eat.
...Oops, bad habit. Sighing right in front of the customers...
It's fine, no one was looking.
Nope, no excuses! Get it together, Nene.
(She's really serious about stuff like that...)
Hey, how old do you think that kid sitting over there is？
They ordered a kids' meal, so they must be younger. Probably third or fourth grade in elementary school...
They really don't look it, though...
They got super excited over the toy, so I'm sure of it. Kids nowadays look so mature.
(Coming from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, that really carries some weight...)
Oh no! Towel, I need a towel!
Yeah, a customer knocked over their water and got it all over themselves.
No, I'm fine. Sorry for the fuss~!
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is always so quick on her feet at times like this...)
Anegasaki-san, the manager is calling for you.
Looked like you were trapped there.
Yeah, she's a regular, but she talks for so long that I always get stuck.
(Always listening anyway is so like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Sorry, could you take table five, please？
Oh, wait. I'll go instead, so take this one, okay？
Because that table's full of pretty women, that's why.
...Hey, what do you think of this display？
Geez, you don't sound like you mean it at all.
That's not true! It's great, really. ●Rave reviews!
Geez, now you're just laying it on thick.
(What am I even supposed to say...？)
Break's coming up soon, so hang in there, okay？
Do I？ Sorry, right in the middle of work, too.
No, only I'd ever notice, so you're totally fine.
Good work. Want some tea？ It's just a tea bag, though.
Yeah, thanks! Nothing beats a cup after work.
Haha, you sound like an old man.
Could you restock the drink station supplies for me？
Sorry, my hands are full right now too. Can it wait？
Yeah, if it's just a bit. It's always busy at this hour.
There're times we don't get to talk at all. ...Whoops! Sorry for the wait!
▲主人公＊▲, do you know much about coffee？
Hmm, just whether it tastes good or bad, pretty much.
I see. Our drink station's coffee actually grinds the beans, right？ Apparently they're switching the beans, so I just did a taste test, but...
Oh really？ I'm looking forward to that.
Yeah, but I couldn't really tell. All I know is they were both just bitter...
Good morning. Hope it stops soon...
Don't like the rain？ ...It's annoying when your shoes get all dirty, right？
That's part of it... but it's more a mood thing.
Then I bet if you change your mindset, you won't mind it at all. Right？
The rain is a little gloomy. Hey, do something about it？
Fufu. Look at that troubled face. Seeing you like that cheered me right up.
My hair wouldn't behave, it was such a pain. It's not sticking up, is it？
Don't worry, it's not sticking up at all.
...You could always pat my head while you're at it, you know？
It's so nice out today. Doesn't look like it'll turn, either.
Looking like this, I think we'll be fine.
Nice weather always puts me in a good mood.
Yeah. Clear skies all the way.
I really wanted clear skies today, so I'm glad.
Is that so？ I'm glad then.
As long as it doesn't rain, I guess.
It's pretty cloudy... Wonder what it'll do？
It'd be nice if it cleared up.
Sure is cloudy. Wonder if it'll stay like this all day？
Yeah, hope the sun comes out.
Hope the rain lets up soon.
I'd love for it to clear up by after school.
Hope it clears up by the time school's out.
Maybe we should ditch school and go on a date right now...
...Sorry, just teasing. We only have to hold out a little longer, right？
Right... You surprised me for a second.
Alright, gotta focus on class now.
Look at you, all fired up.
When a date gets close, I lose all my focus. So I have to remind myself.
That's rare for you, running late.
I fell asleep watching a late-night movie, I think...
Haha, sounds just like you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Jeez, you're so hopeless. Do I need to wake you up myself？
(Ugh... she's treating me like a kid.)
Did I lock the front door, or did I leave it...? ...Yep, I locked it. All good.
Sorry about that, thank you. Looks like I tripped... Good morning.
Morning. I'm just glad you fell my way.
So today, I had a dream about a fake you. When I pinched his arm, he revealed his true form...
Don't worry, I'm the real deal!
I made us lunch today, too. Where do you want to eat？
Ta-da, lunch! Where do you think it'd taste the best？
How about we eat at ▲飲食店＊＊＊＊＊▲？
Sorry. I didn't bring lunch today.
I see. Want to hit the cafeteria, then？
Oh, good idea. We haven't gone there together yet, have we？
I couldn't make lunch today. Are you disappointed？
Can't be helped. Wanna hit the cafeteria？
Sounds good. We haven't gone together yet, anyway.
So, actually... I forgot our lunch at home.
Ah, gotcha. Wanna try the cafeteria？
Yeah, let's. Come to think of it, we've never gone together.
Are you okay with the cafeteria for lunch today？
I'm in the mood for the cafeteria today. How about you？
I'd like to go to the cafeteria today. Is that okay？
Looks delicious. Time to dig in!
Thanks for the meal. That was delicious, wasn't it？
Thanks for the food! Man, I am stuffed.
Hehe. Make sure you don't doze off next period, okay？
Shoot... Overeating always makes me so sleepy...
Jeez, you really need to be careful, okay？
Thanks for the meal. Did you get full？
Yeah, totally stuffed. I'm getting sleepy...
Aren't you eating a bit too much？ Lately your waistline's looking a little...
Just kid-ding♪ Did that wake you up？ Let's hang in there this afternoon.
Thanks for the meal. You looked like you really enjoyed that.
The way you scarf it down feels so manly. It's pretty cool▼
I don't have an umbrella... What should I do？
I hate getting soaked. Glad I brought it.
Yeah. You too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Got an umbrella？
Well then, I forgot mine. Wanna share？
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Ready to head home？
Yeah. Do you have an umbrella？
Too much hassle. Guess I'll just run for it...
Found a boy who forgot his umbrella~
You were just gonna run for it, weren't you？ Poor thing... I'll let you share mine.
You're welcome. Can't have you catching a cold.
Man, it's really coming down... Oh well, time to bolt.
▲主人公＊▲. Pop quiz! What class did I just have？
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Smells good. Cooking class？
Ding-dong!♪ Here's a prize for the winner♪
For me？ Don't mind if I do! Down the hatch!
How does it taste？ I thought it turned out pretty good myself.
Hehe, is it to your liking？
(It's so good... Could this be served at Dixie's？)
I really hope you like it, though.
Did I mess it up a little？
(Not really messed up. Just... average, I guess.)
Um, if it tastes weird, I'm sorry, okay？
(Oof, yeah, it really is a little...)
Maybe it's just not to your taste.
Truth is, I wasn't too confident about it... Ahaha.
Still not waking up？ Such a sleepyhead...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Wait... Was that a dream？
Not a dream. I came to wake you up. Good morning.
Morning... Ah, waking up like this feels like a dream...
I felt like... someone was poking my cheek like crazy...
Must've been a funny dream, huh？ Come on, you have to get ready.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Did you just, on my cheek...？
(Something like that would wake anyone right up.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Morning. You came! You should've just woken me right away, though.
Your sleep-talking was funny, it seemed a shame to wake you.
Don't worry, my lips are sealed. I won't tell a soul.
(I didn't say anything weird, did I, ●...？)
I banged a pan with a ladle, just like a cartoon! Worked like a charm, didn't it？
Up late last night, by the looks of it？ Hurry or you'll be late, you know？
Yawning with your mouth wide open, just like a kid. Want me to dress you？
No way, I'm good! I'm getting up, I swear...
Good morning. Perfect timing. Breakfast is fresh and ready.
Thanks... It's been so long since I had a breakfast like this.
I'm glad. Now go wash your face, okay？
Good morning. You're up! Let's eat before breakfast gets cold, okay？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Morning. Thanks for making breakfast.
I wanted to eat with you, too. Here you go, dig in!
(Man, this really feels like we're newlyweds...)
Well？ Delicious enough to make your cheeks fall off？
Totally falling off! It's so good!
Truth is, I'm not totally satisfied with it.
It's fine, it's fine! It's plenty good.
I'm a little unsure of myself... Is it no good？
Haha... Well, I'm definitely gonna finish it.
Yep, I wanted to eat together with you.
I thought toast would be nice. Eat plenty, okay？
Morning. Let's eat breakfast together, okay？
Morning, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Ah, that toast smells so good...
You need a solid breakfast to get your energy up. I've got seconds ready, too!
This morning's breakfast turned out perfectly. How is it？
Getting to eat this well first thing in the morning... ● is one lucky guy!
I made it in a rush, so the seasoning might not be quite right.
No way, it's actually pretty good.
I think I rushed through it a little too much...
Uh... Don't worry, it's not like it's inedible.
Hey, what are you doing for dinner tonight？ If you don't have plans, I could come cook for you.
Oh, you too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Then let's walk home together.
Of course. And, you know, I was thinking maybe I could cook dinner at your place tonight.
I'd love to♪ By the way... what would you say if I came over to cook you dinner tonight？
I see... That's too bad, but let's do it next time.
Really？ Yay! Then let's hit the supermarket on the way home.
This supermarket is basically like my own fridge, you know.
Shopping with a guy makes buying a bunch of stuff so easy!
Uh... yeah, leave it to me.
You know, this supermarket actually carries some pretty rare seasonings.
So, what do you feel like eating tonight？
I'm kind of in the mood for ▲メニュー▲ tonight.
Hey, that's my specialty! Leave it all to me♪
Yeah, I think I can handle that.
Um... I think I can manage？
All right, let's grab the ingredients.
Did we buy a bit too much？ It looks like it'll be tough carrying it all back.
Thanks for carrying that. That took quite a while, didn't it？
We made it. It's not really cleaned up, but don't mind the mess.
Maybe I should inspect every little corner~
We're finally here. Thanks for hanging in there.
You're the one who had all those heavy bags, right？ Good job, you.
Having ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ come over to cook after school... It feels so new.
Really, come to think of it, this is the first time.
I'm home~ ...Wait! This is your house, though. Hehe▼
All right, I'll get started on dinner right away.
You're hungry, right？ I'll hurry and make it, so wait just a bit, okay？
Well, we've got all the ingredients, so I'll get started!
Thanks for today! That totally hit the spot!
You're very welcome. I'll come cook for you again, okay？
Yeah. Well, it's late, so I'll walk you home.
I can get home on my own, so don't worry. See you later!
Today was a lot of fun. Dinner was delicious too, thanks!
No, no, you're welcome. If you're a good boy, I'll cook for you again.
Then since I'm a good boy, I'll walk you home.
It's fine, don't fuss. You just rest up, okay？ See you... Bye-bye.
Man, today was great! All thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You're welcome. I can come cook for you anytime▼
Thanks. ...All right, shall we head out？
Oh, you don't have to walk me. You'll just tire yourself out, right？ So... bye-bye!
Feeling better？ I'm definitely walking you home tonight.
Yeah... I'll take you up on that, then.
Did I ever mention that I keep a diary？
Ah, did you？ I can't remember.
It's actually pretty fun, you know？
Yeah. Reading it back later gives you perspective, so it feels fresh.
Huh, what kind of things do you write？
(...Wait, what？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s diary... Now I'm really curious...)
